Fixed in 076f7c6372. The harness registers each plugin's onDispose, and afterEach calls them all and waits before deleting the temp directories, so no pending planner call outlives its test.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch. Both assertions now use `should(value)`, which fails on `undefined` instead of short-circuiting. Checked by mutation: with the proto-to-host converter dropping `annotations`, the round-trip test now fails.

Fixed in 202642e: parseStatus now keeps the original path on R/C records (originalPath on the file entry). The webview includes it in unstage actions (unstagePaths helper, used for row, group, and breadcrumb unstage) and passes it to get_git_file_diff so a staged rename reads HEAD at the old path. Covered by a real-repo test that git mv's a file, checks the diff shows the old contents, unstages both paths, and verifies the old path is no longer staged as a deletion.
Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.
Fixed in 3e546f0: stage, unstage, and discard run with --literal-pathspecs. Test stages and discards a file literally named draft*.txt next to draft1.txt and checks the sibling survives.

Fixed in ac405ed: previews compare a symlink by its link text, which is what git stores. Locally the working side uses lstat/readlink; over SSH the index mode (120000) triggers a remote readlink. The explorer itself still follows links on purpose. Real-repo test repoints a committed link and checks old/new are the link texts.

Fixed in ac405ed: the SSH listing now runs a small POSIX sh script (folder passed as a positional argument) whose [ -d ] test follows symlinks, so a link to a folder gets the trailing slash and expands like locally; dotfiles and dangling links are still listed. The script is executed for real in project-files.test.ts against a temp folder with a linked folder and a dangling link.

Fixed in 24f543400: each side is now read by its own mode (sideContents): gitlink sides render as 'Subproject commit <sha>', regular sides as blob contents, for commit and staged previews; the working side falls back to the file reader when a submodule was replaced by a file. The real-submodule test commits a submodule-to-file replacement and checks the new side shows the file's contents.

Valid, and fixed in 1690c40bf. I removed the cap. Each failure record is what stops its run from falling back to an earlier checkpoint, so failures now persist for the life of the session, as checkpoint history does. Covered by `keeps every failure so no failed run falls back to an earlier checkpoint` in `checkpoint-records.test.ts`; it fails if the cap is put back.

Added two cases: a `tool_call.id` given as a number, which checks the message names `tool_call.id`, and a payload missing four required fields, which checks exactly three are listed. Each one fails if I break the matching part of the formatting (joining the path, or the `slice(0, 3)` limit).
it strips every plural suffix so a Russian catalog missing `_few`/`_many` passes. the catalog is good today but nothing guards it.
agent: guarded in 3d7457208 — new test requires every plural group to carry exactly the locale's CLDR cardinal categories

Valid, thanks. The wire-level test now runs the same assertions through `doStream` as well as `doGenerate`, for both `cline` and `cline-pass`, and checks the request is a streaming one. Removing the headers from the Cline provider fails all four cases.
